identity_is_the_owner_on_the_engine.meaning: the consumer's token authenticates as the client that owns the worlds it creates; the marked test identity is refused on them

b1_read_grant_to_archaeon.direction: OWNER = Vivarium grants; GRANTEE = Archaeon's engine client (config.json read_scopes[0].grantee)
b1_read_grant_to_archaeon.grantee_side_read_to_verify: GET /v2/read/worlds?scope=scp_4aff817e018de830f9193cbd as the grantee (sfclient.read_worlds(scope=...)); expect 26 viv-* worlds; a 403/404 means the grant is not live
b1_read_grant_to_archaeon.what_closes_it: Archaeon registers its Campaign-4 client on THIS ledger (P1) and tells Vivarium the client_id; Vivarium sets read_scopes[0].grantee to it (a committed, non-secret config change + pin advance); the next batch boundary grants every viv-* world. Not an engine-side action; not Daedalus's.
